facts.fact: ONECI, the Office national de l'etat civil et de l'identification, is the only body authorised to issue the secure national identity card, through enrolment centres such as Grand-Bassam.

CIV.note: No register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: ONECI enrols applicants and issues the national identity card, with a stamp bought online, enrolment at an approved centre and a notification to collect the produced card.
